name: kelch repeat and BTB domain containing 4

function.text: KBTBD4 encodes kelch repeat and BTB domain-containing protein 4. It participates in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Medulloblastoma; Pineal parenchymal tumor of intermediate differentiation. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
